## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run ci` passes
- [ ] No new remote executable code or external script loading
- [ ] No browsing/user data upload, telemetry, analytics, account sync, or device/install identifiers
- [ ] No permission expansion, or the change includes a clear necessity review
- [ ] Third-party source/license/attribution updated if applicable
- [ ] Relevant browser package tested locally
